verdict.rationale: Airwallex's US cards page headline advertises '2% Cashback' on its corporate cards, so a cashback program on card spend exists. That page title is the only evidence, and nothing shows how cashback is earned, credited or redeemed, so the 'automatic, no manual redemption' core of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: documentation that cashback is credited automatically without redemption steps, eligibility and terms details, and independent or hands-on confirmation of cashback payouts.
